I am an old woman here in Dedza, and this small plot near my house is where my maize must grow to feed us. I will put some fertilizer if I can get the subsidy coupon, but only a little because money is short, and I always put the manure from my goats and chickens on the field before planting. I keep some seed from last year but this season I want to try the hybrid seed if I can buy a small packet, and I plant beans and pumpkins together with the maize like we always do. My sons and grandchildren help me, and sometimes I call a neighbour for piecework when weeding time comes and my back is paining.
